name: Zylann/godot_voxel
description: A C++ module/GDExtension for creating volumetric terrains in Godot Engine 4, supporting blocky Minecraft-style terrain, smooth marching-cube terrain, level of detail, and infinite streaming.
score_rationale: 3.6k stars, the definitive voxel terrain solution for Godot with active February 2026 releases and comprehensive LOD/streaming capabilities.
summary: Godot voxel terrain extension with LOD and infinite streaming support
